Thanks for sending this over, Elena — appreciate the clear context.

Two quick asks so our tax ops team can validate and clear MW-20270118 without delay:
- Please confirm the purchaser legal name and FEIN exactly as it appears on the certificate (we need it to match the invoice entity).
- For IL and MN we typically require either (a) the state seller permit number listed on the certificate or (b) an explicit statement in the certificate that it covers sales of tangible personal property and taxable services to the purchaser. MO sometimes requires a notarized business-use affidavit for SaaS; can you confirm whether your certificate was notarized?

Cc'ing Neha (tax ops) and Vanessa (your account lead) to coordinate. Vanessa — let's hold the invoice until tax ops confirms; I'll mark it as "pending resale validation" in billing.

Hi Elena — thanks for the attachment. To validate and remove the invoice hold we need the following (checklist):

1) Purchaser legal name and FEIN as printed on the certificate (exact match to invoice entity).
2) Scanned copy of a business license or articles of organization showing the IL registration page (we received a partial image in your PDF; please include the full page).
3) If the certificate is notarized, please attach the notarized page; if not notarized, provide a signed affidavit for MO (simple template attached).
4) Point of sale / delivery state mapping for the charges on MW-20270118 — if any line items are physical shipments to consumers in a nexus state we may still need regime-specific proof.

I attached our Missouri affidavit template (Signed-COI.pdf) and a short checklist that speeds validation. Once we have 1–3 and confirm the invoice entity match, we can clear the hold. Turnaround target: 48 business hours after receiving full docs.

Also: if Midwest can provide the state seller permit numbers for IL and MN that will make validation straightforward. Otherwise we'll need to rely on the breadth language in the certificate plus the business license.

Regards,
Neha Kapoor
Tax Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
